annotations.text:
Current layout, recreated from the real CharacterPage.js/.scss.

What it's missing: character name, class, and player name appear nowhere on the page (only in the browser tab title). The purple bar is empty by default.

The ability-score and HP/AC boxes are fixed-width (400px + 500px) and don't fill the row — at real desktop widths this leaves a large dead black gap to the right, which is the empty space you see in your screenshot.

v2 — Roleplay / Combat / Combat Map redesigned (per your scope); Inventory intentionally left as a stub for a later pass.

Working prototype: click the Roleplay / Combat / Inventory / Combat Map pills to switch modes, and click the Action Point stars in Combat mode to test the resource tracker. The masthead color is a tweak (chip above the artboard) standing in for the existing per-character color picker.

"Character Name" / "Class Name" are placeholders — everything else in Roleplay mode (skills, stats, background, notes) is your real data from the screenshot. Combat actions and map zones are illustrative sample content.

Mobile v2 — all four modes, including Inventory this time.

What's different from the desktop version, and why:

• The mode switcher moves to a fixed bottom tab bar (thumb reach) instead of top pills.

• Skills & Flaws can't stay a persistent 300px sidebar at this width — it's now a summary row that opens a slide-up drawer over the screen. Tap "Skills & Flaws" to open it, tap the scrim or the X to close.

• Inventory is redesigned from scratch here: the desktop app's multi-column drag-and-drop board (4 relic slots + 8 backpack slots + a pocket, all side-by-side) doesn't fit a 390px screen, so it's restructured as stacked sections — a 2x2 Relics grid, a scrollable Backpack list, and the Pocket as its own highlighted card. Empty slots are shown honestly rather than hidden.

Working prototype: tap the bottom tabs, the AP stars in Combat, and the Skills & Flaws row.
